verses.1: And Dinah, the daughter of Lea, who was born to Jacob, went out to see the fruits of the earth.
verses.2: And Shechem, daughter of Hamor the Hivite, king of the land, he took her and lay with her and slept with her.
verses.3: And his soul became attached to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young girl and talked with her heart to heart.
verses.4: And Shechem said to her father Hamor, “Give me this girl as a wife.”
verses.5: And Jacob heard that Dinah had been taken away from him. His sons were with him in the field, and Jacob waited until they returned.
verses.6: And Hammed, son of Shechem, went to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.7: And the sons of Jacob came out from the field when they heard this. The people were terrified, and they were filled with great fear, for it seemed like a curse that would be brought upon Israel if they slept with the daughter of Jacob. But such a thing should never happen.
verses.8: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, “Your daughters are beautiful. Please give them to me as wives.”
verses.9: And we shall humble ourselves before you. Give us your daughters, and your daughters will be taken away from us.
verses.10: And we shall sit here, and the land will be yours. You may settle in it and trade on it.
verses.11: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Do you really think that I will give you any kindness? After all, what will you say to me?”
verses.12: I am given too much quickly, and I receive and give as you say to me. You give me the young man for a woman.
verses.13: And the sons of Jacob answered them with deceit and dishonesty. They spoke in a way that misled their father’s laws.
verses.14: And they said to them, “We cannot do this. It would be a shame to give our sister to a man who is impure. It would be a disgrace for us.”
verses.15: But it’s unfortunate for you if you become like us, and have to bear all these memories with you.
verses.16: And we will give our daughters to you. And your daughters will be taken from you, and they will sit with us. Then we will become one people.
verses.17: And if you do not listen to us, then we will take away our daughters from you and go away.
verses.18: And their words pleased Hamor’s eyes, as well as Shechem’s eyes.
verses.19: And it was not the boy who had to do this deed, because he desired the daughter of Jacob. He was protected from all the evils in his father’s house.
verses.20: And Hamor and Shechem’s son went to the gates of their city. They spoke to the people of their city, saying:
verses.21: These men are strong and capable. They will settle on this land and cultivate it. The land before them is as wide as their hands. Their daughters will be given to us as wives, and our daughters will be given to them.
verses.22: But in this way, we will be able to unite as one people, just as they were once united. All those memories will be remembered, just as they were before they were scattered.
verses.23: Their flocks and herds, and all their animals, they have given them to us. But we must take care of them and let them live among us.
verses.24: And El-Hamor and El-Shchem heard this. All those who lived outside the city’s gates also heard it. They reported everything that happened outside the city’s gates.
verses.25: On the third day, while they were still in pain, they took two of Jacob’s sons: Shemuel and Levi, brothers of Dinah. They entered the city with confidence and killed everyone who was there.
verses.26: And Hamor and Shechem’s men were killed according to the agreement. They took Dinah from the house of Shechem and fled away.
verses.27: The sons of Jacob came upon the captives and destroyed the city that they had built.
verses.28: Their flocks, their herds, their houses, and everything that was in the city and in the fields were taken away.
verses.29: And all their armies, and all their soldiers, and their women also returned. They took back everything that was in the house.
verses.30: And Jacob said to Shemuel and Levi, “You have abandoned me to live in the land of Canaan and the Philistines. I am old and weak. Please gather me together, and I will be saved from them. I will be saved along with my household.”
verses.31: And they said, “Kazonah will do what we ask him to do.”
